assertions.title: Signal bus creates topics and emits/receives

steps.action: Navigate to http://localhost:5174/?debug=1, clear localStorage, reload
steps.observed: Page loaded successfully, window.__nispsBus is an object with createTopic, getTopic, match methods

steps.action: Create topics test.a and test.b, subscribe to each, emit values 42 and 99
steps.observed: topicResults = [{sub:'a',data:42},{sub:'b',data:99},{sub:'a',data:100},{sub:'b',data:200}] — subscribers received all emitted values

steps.action: Subscribe to wildcard pattern 'test.*' via bus.match(), then emit 100 and 200 to test.a and test.b
steps.expected: Wildcard subscriber captures emits after match() subscription
steps.observed: wildcardResults = [100, 200, 1, 1] — captured emits from test.a, test.b, and test.same matching test.*

steps.expected: sameDataCount is 2 (equals:false ensures every emit triggers subscriber)
steps.observed: sameDataCount = 2 — both emits triggered the subscriber even with identical data

steps.action: Navigate to http://localhost:5174/?debug=1 (already loaded from VAL-PROJ-004)
steps.observed: window.__nisps exists and is an object (not null)

steps.action: Check typeof for all 15 required methods
steps.observed: All 15 methods present: getOutputs, getLoss, getWeights, getExampleCount, setInputs, thumbsUp, thumbsDown, train, trainAsync, randomise, clearExamples, saveState, evalLoss, inferBatch, getLayerStats — allPresent: true

frictions.description: The validation contract task description referenced bus.topic() API but the actual implementation uses bus.createTopic()/getTopic(). The match() method takes (pattern, callback) directly rather than returning a subscribable object. Required reading the source code to discover the correct API.
frictions.resolution: Read src/bus/signal-bus.ts to identify the actual API: createTopic(name), getTopic(name), match(pattern, fn)

frictions.description: Arrow function callbacks in eval() caused 'ms.fn is not a function' error on first attempt after page reload with cleared localStorage. Switching to function declarations resolved it, suggesting a possible serialization issue with arrow functions in the browser eval context.
frictions.resolution: Used function declarations instead of arrow functions in eval() JavaScript code

summary: Tested 3 assertions: all 3 passed. VAL-PROJ-004 (signal bus): topics emit/receive correctly, wildcard matching works, equals:false ensures duplicate data triggers subscribers. VAL-PROJ-005 (debug probe with ?debug=1): all 15 required methods present. VAL-PROJ-006 (no probe without ?debug=1): window.__nisps is undefined.
